Storage in valve connective tissue thickens the leaflets and produces regurgitation.

edges.limitations: Lyset knockout mice did not display the obvious clinical symptoms seen in human patients, which is the same discrepancy already known for the Gnptab knockout mouse. The model therefore reports on the trafficking lesion and not on the skeletal phenotype that defines the human disease.

edges.description: Unlike the mouse, the zebrafish reproduces a skeletal phenotype, so it is currently the only whole-organism model that reaches the tissue-level disease.
edges.limitations: Zebrafish skeletal development differs substantially from human endochondral ossification, and the reported phenotype is a developmental dysplasia in the embryo rather than the progressive postnatal dysostosis multiplex of patients. Cardiac oedema has no clear human counterpart in this disorder.

nodes.description: Homozygous loss-of-function variants in LYSET (TMEM251) abolish or functionally cripple the small Golgi transmembrane protein LYSET. Soluble acid hydrolases are no longer tagged with mannose-6-phosphate, the recognition marker read by the M6P receptors that route them from the trans-Golgi network to the lysosome. Because the marker is shared by roughly seventy soluble hydrolases, the defect is a simultaneous functional deficiency of many enzymes rather than of one.
